training.checkpoint: Final epoch; no early stopping or calibration-based epoch selection
training.standardization: Fit-only per-channel mean/scale using the corresponding arm/split contexts
training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss; pos_weight=fit negative count / fit positive count; equal context weights, shuffled seeded batches
training.scope: All corresponding fit sources retained in inventory; only prefix/target contexts enter continuous fitting; no post contexts or held-out media in fitting

sampling.event_anchor: supplied annotation frame without legacy boundary clamping

inference.missing_contexts: No interpolation, no predictions; missing hops reset persistence; empty clips retained as misses

calibration.prefix: end_pts < event_pts - 1; macro mean over supported clips only
calibration.selection: Maximize calibration event recall subject to both caps; ties prefer fewer off-target episodes, then lower macro prefix fraction, then higher threshold; infeasible remains unselected

execution_order: Freeze and test execution implementations before real jobs
Verify every selected source and decoded context against PTS before accepting features
Fit all eight models without test scoring
Replay corresponding TRAIN holdouts and freeze all operating policies
Only then replay both new fixed test cohorts and publish every model/control

evaluation.primary: Four paired continuous-minus-anchored event recall contrasts by feature/split
secondary: Macro prefix positive fraction and support
Detected-case median and p95 signed trigger delay
controls: Same-grid always-positive clock-only; same gate and event bands
evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired source-clip percentile resamples, seed42, pointwise95%; conditional on one fitted seed and calibration
evaluation.failure_policy: Source/decoder/provenance mismatch stops publication; no replacement or outcome-based exclusion

scope: Calibration-motivated joint context-phase/label intervention, not a pure architecture effect. Reused TRAIN holdouts are development data. New continuous-event cohorts exclude prior event replays, but their earlier window-test observations are known. Prefixes are accident-clip annotations, not independently reviewed normal cameras.
representation_gate: VideoMAE or another representation requires a separate frozen arm under these same source/context/label contracts; no unmatched architecture claims
default_policy: Retain all original 500-clip binaries/defaults and prior study artifacts; no test-based promotion
